title: head
summary: Return the first rows of a table, timetable, or array.

gpu_support.notes: GPU-resident array input is supported. It is downloaded non-destructively and the selected value is restored to the owning provider with its class preserved. A GPU-resident row-count control is a separately gated RunMat extension.

description: `head(A, n)` selects the first `n` rows. The default row count is 8. All eight integer array classes preserve exact storage and trailing dimensions.
behaviors: Real, complex, logical, and integer arrays preserve every trailing dimension while selecting along dimension one.
Typed integer row counts are decoded exactly and must be positive.
GPU-resident data is supported in MATLAB-compatible modes; a GPU-resident row-count control remains gated before provider access.
